source_note: 给正项级数条件正负号以后级数收敛意味着什么
english_source_note: What Sign Choices Imply for Positive Series Convergence
callout_id: 给正项级数条件正负号以后级数收敛意味着什么#1
statement_en:
Assume $p_n$ is a nonincreasing sequence of positive real numbers, and let $\varepsilon_n\in\{-1,1\}$ be such that the series $\sum_{n\geq 1}\varepsilon_n p_n$ converges. Then:
1. If $\sum_{n\geq 1} p_n$ diverges, then the upper limit of the arithmetic means of $\varepsilon_n$ is at least $0$ and the lower limit is at most $0$, that is,
$$\liminf_{n\to \infty}\frac{\varepsilon_1+\cdots+\varepsilon_n}{n}\leq 0\leq \limsup_{n\to \infty}\frac{\varepsilon_1+\cdots+\varepsilon_n}{n}.$$
2. $$(\varepsilon_1+\cdots+\varepsilon_n)p_n\to 0.$$
key_techniques: necessary conditions for convergence of series
callout_body:
假设$p_n$是单调不增的正实数列,令$\varepsilon_k\in \{-1,1\}$是使得级数$\sum_{n\geq 1}\varepsilon_n p_n$收敛的序列，那么：
1. 如果$\sum_{n\geq 1} p_n$是发散的级数那么$\varepsilon_n$的算术平均值的上极限大于等于0，下极限小于等于0，即$$\liminf_{n\to \infty}\frac{\varepsilon_1+\cdots+\varepsilon_n}{n}\leq 0\leq \limsup_{n\to \infty}\frac{\varepsilon_1+\cdots+\varepsilon_n}{n}$$
2. $$(\varepsilon_1+\cdots+\varepsilon_n)p_n\to 0$$
